name: Critical material supply risk exposure
description: Supply risk of the raw materials a company's industry runs on - higher means it depends more on materials mined in few, badly governed countries
source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 + World Bank WGI

name: Critical material dependence stated in the 10-K
description: Combined supply risk of the critical materials a company names in its own annual report - higher means it discloses dependence on more, riskier minerals

name: Federal contract revenue concentration
description: NOT an environmental measure - political/contractor concentration risk. Direct federal procurement contract obligations as a share of revenue - higher means more exposure to a federal budget or policy shift. Does not capture subcontractor exposure.
source: SEC XBRL quarterly revenue + USASpending.gov federal contract obligations

name: GHG emissions intensity (GHGRP-matched companies)
description: Direct CO2e emissions from a company's large US industrial/power facilities per $M revenue, as a percentile rank among matched companies each year - higher means dirtier per dollar of revenue
unit: percentile rank 0-1 (within matched companies, not the full S&P 500 - see script docstring)
